summary.ja: 正の電子数密度から電子間反発のHartree場とエネルギーを求める。公開実装は球対称密度のCoulomb積分を内側・外側の累積和で評価し、汎用の3次元Poissonソルバーは用いない。
summary.en: Compute the repulsive Hartree field and energy from positive electron-number density. The released implementation evaluates spherical Coulomb integrals using inward/outward cumulative sums, not a general three-dimensional Poisson solver.

assumptions: A nonnegative spherically symmetric electron-number density n(r), with p(r)=4 pi r^2 n(r) and integral p dr=N; released helium uses N=2.
For an isolated system, v_H(r)=integral_0^R p(s)/max(r,s) ds and E_H=(1/2) integral p(r)v_H(r) dr.
The code uses uniform-grid cumulative quadrature with p=0 at the two endpoints and zero density outside the finite box; the same-radius quadrature sample is counted once.

v_H is positive electron repulsion and satisfies Laplacian(v_H)=-4 pi n in atomic units. Signed electronic charge density is -n; v_H is electron potential energy, not the electrostatic potential generated by that negative charge.
units: Atomic units: r in bohr, n in bohr^(-3), p in bohr^(-1), N an electron number, v_H and E_H in hartree. The positive-number-density convention fixes the Poisson sign.
boundary_conditions: Isolated spherical Coulomb boundary: v_H is finite at the origin and equals N/r outside the truncated density support. It is not a zero-Dirichlet condition at r_max. Endpoint p=0 is inherited from the reduced orbital; no periodic neutrality/background convention is implemented.

next_deliverable.ja: 既存の小規模例の固定入力・保存済み参照・配布物の整合を維持し、必要時に少数の代表ケースを再実行する。大規模な基底・k点走査、重い独立参照の再生成、長時間BOMD／CPMDは、必要性が指定された場合だけ別途検討する。
next_deliverable.en: Maintain fixed inputs, saved references and release integrity for the existing small examples; rerun a few representative cases when needed. Large basis/k-point sweeps, expensive independent-reference regeneration and long BOMD/CPMD trajectories are considered separately only on explicit need.

limitations.ja: 球対称・孤立・有限箱で切断した密度用の積分評価。非球対称、一般の境界形状、周期系、Ewaldや背景電荷、点電荷の特異自己エネルギーは扱わない。同半径標本の重複回避は求積の会計であり、DFTの物理的自己相互作用を除去する操作ではない。He HFでの自己相互作用相殺は別の交換簡約に由来する。
limitations.en: An integral evaluator for spherical isolated densities truncated in a finite box. It does not treat nonspherical/general boundaries, periodicity, Ewald/background charges or singular point-charge self-energies. Avoiding a double-counted same-radius sample is quadrature bookkeeping, not removal of DFT self-interaction; the helium-HF cancellation comes from the separate exchange reduction.

assumptions_ja: 非負・球対称の電子数密度n(r)を仮定。p(r)=4πr²n(r)、∫p dr=Nと定義し、公開He例はN=2。
一様格子の累積求積を用い、両端p=0、有限箱外の密度は0とする。同じ半径の求積標本を1回だけ数える。
v_Hは正の電子間反発で、原子単位系で∇²v_H=−4πn。符号付き電子電荷密度は−nであり、v_Hは負電荷が作る静電ポテンシャルそのものではなく電子のポテンシャルエネルギー。
units_ja: 原子単位系。rはbohr、nはbohr⁻³、pはbohr⁻¹、Nは電子数、v_HとE_Hはhartree。正の電子数密度という規約とPoisson式の符号を組にする。
boundary_conditions_ja: 孤立・球対称Coulomb境界。v_Hは原点で有限、切断した密度の外側ではN/r。r_maxで0とするDirichlet条件ではない。端点p=0は縮約軌道から与え、周期系の中性化・背景電荷の規約は実装していない。

caution.ja: Poisson解の残差、積分した電子数、遠方の挙動、二重計数の1/2を別々に確かめます。周期セルの帯電系を孤立系のエネルギーとして解釈しません。
caution.en: Check the Poisson residual, integrated electron number, far-field behavior and the one-half double-counting factor separately. A charged periodic cell does not directly give an isolated-system energy.

example_scope.ja: 球対称孤立密度のCoulomb積分を累積和で評価。解析的な指数密度で符号・係数・自己項の数え方を検証。一般の3Dや周期のPoisson実装ではありません。
example_scope.en: Cumulative Coulomb quadrature for isolated spherical densities, checked against analytic exponential densities; not a general 3D or periodic Poisson implementation.

problem.ja: 与えた球対称電子数密度が作る孤立系Coulomb反発場とHartreeエネルギーを求める。
problem.en: Find the isolated repulsive Coulomb field and Hartree energy of a specified spherical electron-number density.

variant.ja: 動径密度pに対する内側・外側積分の累積求積。Poisson式は符号と境界の等価な記述で、専用PDE反復解法ではない。
variant.en: Cumulative inner/outer radial quadrature in p; Poisson's equation provides the equivalent sign/boundary interpretation, not a separate iterative PDE solver.

en: Evaluate v_H and E_H for smooth spherical electron densities.
Check sign, boundaries and accounting against analytic exponential density and the N/r far field.

en: Applying this one-dimensional Coulomb integral directly to nonspherical or periodic systems.
Confusing quadrature sample counting with point-charge self-energy removal or exchange.
